::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 31st [1854?]  
**From:** Dogmersfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Royal Institution of Cornwall, Enys No. 1428
:::

Madam
I am much obliged for your great kindness in allowing [my mother](people/person_1606.qmd) and myself the perusal of the enclosed valuable letter. I have been from home for some days, or I would sooner have returned it, and expressed our best thanks for the favour of its perusal

yours much obliged
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** The mourning paper and ‘my mother and myself’ suggest a date after the death of WCY (26 February 1854). Black-edged paper.  The letter has been sold by the owner since we transcribed it and is no longer held by the Courtney Library.
